title: Evidence of conceptual mastery in the application of rules by Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates the conceptual mastery of LLMs through rule application and legal reasoning, which are core topics in epistemology and legal philosophy. It evaluates how models interpret the 'spirit' versus the 'letter' of rules (text vs. purpose), a form of normative reasoning. Additionally, it explicitly references and builds upon research into LLM morality and moral reasoning.
